summary: Form W-7 is the IRS application for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN), the 9-digit U.S. tax number for people who need one but cannot get a Social Security number, and for renewing an ITIN that has expired. Each person applying, including a spouse or child, fills in their own form, usually attached to the U.S. federal tax return that needs the number.

fields.label: Application type (check one box): Apply for a new ITIN / Renew an existing ITIN
